Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all that we have from this game. The warm-up games are done but we will have the two group stage games on Thursday, 21st October 2021. First, we will have the clash between Bangladesh and Papua New Guinea at 2 pm local (10 am GMT), followed by the game between Scotland and Oman at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT). Do join us then. Cheers!

Earlier on in the first innings. After deciding to bat, the Afghanistan batters did well to put up an above par score on the board, with 189/5. All thanks to the half-century knocks by their opening pair, followed by some handy cameos by the middle order. Their bowlers stepped up to the task and defended the score successfully in the end.

The batters did not turn up to the occasion for West Indies. Mohammad Nabi managed to spin the web around the top-order and got rid of three batsmen early on. Lendl Simmons was sent back on a duck. While, Lewis and Hetmyer went cheaply. Then Roston Chase and Pooran stitched a crucial partnership to take their team to safer shores. After 10 overs, Afghanistan were 100/1, while West Indies saw themselves at 50/3. They were already 50 runs behind, and some dot balls and some rare boundaries meant that the run rate kept creeping up. Pooran skittled out, as he looked to go big and cool down the run rate. Chase and Russell knocked some runs in the end, but the latter fell short. In the end, West Indies were defeated by 56 runs.

It was the NABI show with his magic arm. He got rid of both the openers, Lendl Simmons and Evin Lewis as well as the hard-hitting Shimron Hetmyer. After 6.3 overs, West Indies were at a teetering position at 27/3. While, Mohammad Nabi ended with the figures of (4-2-2-3), which included two maiden-wicket overs. He was in some top-notch form. He was supported well by Mujeeb Ur Rahman during the Powerplay and kept the run rate within control. There was a patch when a partnership was brewing, but Karim Janat made sure to get the breakthrough. Naveen picked up a wicket in the final over to get rid of Andre Russell. It was a demanding victory for the Afghans.

Another disappointing show by the defending champions and this will be their second defeat in the warm-up games. They would hope their fortune to turn around at the mega event. Afghanistan, on the other hand, have certainly managed to iron the chink of their last game, as their batters did the job for them in this game. It was a tremendous performance by Afghanistan.
A slower short ball on middle, Hayden Walsh looks to pull but misses. Afghanistan win by 56 runs!
Around off, hit over covers for a single.

Full toss, around middle, Walsh pushes this to the mid off region. They go for the single but this is hit straight to Gulbadin Naib there. He collects and has a shy at the non-striker's end, but misses. Had he hit, Walsh would be running all the way back to the hut.
Full and straight, Hayden Walsh does well to jam this one out through square leg for a couple of runs.
Hayden Walsh comes out at number 7.

OUT! CAUGHT! Andre Russell's struggle comes to a close. Good-length delivery, around off, Andre Russell stays deep in the crease and looks to clear the long on fence, but he does not quite time it well. An easy take for Gulbadin Naib in the deep.
Slower, short, around off, flat-batted over mid off for a single.
Naveen-ul-Haq comes back into the attack to bowl the final over. He has given away only 7 runs off his two overs.
A pacy short ball now, on middle, Andre Russell looks for the pull shot but misses yet again.
Slower ball, around off on a length, Andre wants to smack this over the leg side but fails to connect.
On middle, heaved through mid-wicket for a run.
On a length on off, hit down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Around off, on a length, Andre Russell looks to heave this to the leg side but he gets the inside edge and the ball runs away to the fine leg fence.
Good-length ball around off, Russell bunts this to the leg side.
Karim Janat (2-0-24-1) comes back into the attack to bowl the penultimate over.
Around off, played through covers for one.
This is played to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Fifty for Roston Chase! It has taken him a while but he has batted with some patience out in the middle. Short and wide outside off, Roston Chase frees his arms and slams this one over the cover region for a boundary.
Short, on off, pulled down to long on for one.
Short and wide outside off, AR looks to slash it away but misses.
Slower, short, around off, Russell looks to pull but then does not go for the shot this time.
Gulbadin Naib (1-0-8-0) is back into the attack.
Fuller again, on middle and leg, Chase misses his slog to the leg side and is hit on the pad. Another excited appeal for LBW from Rashid but the umpire says no. 75 more needed in 18 balls!
Flatter, around middle and leg, angling down, Russell misses his heave again and the keeper fails to stop it too. A bye is stolen.
Around off and middle, Andre Russell gets low and looks to heave it away to the leg side but misses and the ball takes the body and goes to the off side.
Floated, around middle and leg, Andre Russell prods forward looking to defend but misses and gets pinged on the pad. An appeal for LBW but turned down.
Flatter, shorter, on middle, knocked through mid-wicket for one.
Darted on the leg pole, Chase looks to heave it away but misses.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Chase looks to sweep it away but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Chase looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Just a single off the Free Hit! Around off and middle, fuller, dug out through square leg and a run is taken.
Rashid Khan is back into the attack.

OUT? Nopes. It is a NO BALL! That was very well bowled but Hamid Hassan had overstepped and hence, will be not out. A laser-guided yorker, on middle, Roston Chase tries to dig this one out but he fails to do so and the middle stump is uprooted. Will not matter as this was a no ball. Free Hit coming up...
A good bumper, around off, Roston looks to pull but misses.
Around off, pulled to the leg side for one.

Short ball, around off, Andre Russell flat-bats it over covers this time. They take one and decide to take the second. The throw comes from the deep to the keeper, who collects and whips the bails off. An appeal for run out but the umpire thinks that Russell was in. Replays show that Andre Russell was actually short of the crease. Should have been out.
Fuller, on middle, hit down to long off for one.
SIX! Good hit! Short, around off, at a decent height and Roston Chase latches onto this by smacking it well over deep mid-wicket.
Slower length ball, wide outside off, Roston Chase reaches it and slaps it to long off for a single.
Back of a length, on off, Andre Russell slaps it towards long off for a single.

OUT!  Gone this time! Full, on the stumps, Nicholas Pooran looks to get under it and smash it over long on. But fails to get the elevation and hits it straight to Mohammad Nabi at long on. He takes a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nabi b Karim Janat

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Short ball and Nicholas Pooran rocks back quickly to pull this away towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Fuller, on the stumps, Chase drills it to long on for a single.
Andre Russell strides out into the middle!

FIVE WIDES! Karim Janat bowls this way down the leg side.  The wicketkeeper dives to his left but fails to stop it and the ball races away towards the boundary at fine leg. Roston Chase the batter there decides to not go after that ball as it is way too wide.
Full ball, around off, Pooran drills it hard towards long off. The fielder there fumbles a little but in the end stops it to just a single.
Fuller, on the pads, Nicholas Pooran looks to flick it away. But misses. The ball hits his pads and rolls away towards square leg. The batters take a leg bye.
Slower, length ball, on off, Roston Chase makes room and hits this to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Roston Chase gets a lucky boundary this time! On a length, outside off, Chase looks to cut it hard but gets an outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
Fuller, on off, Nicholas Pooran drills it to long off for a single.
SIX! Dispatched! Length ball, on the pads, Nicholas Pooran whips this off his pads over deep square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! Shorter length and pulled away! Short ball, around leg. Nicholas Pooran gets back and pulls it to backward square leg for a boundary.

Floated and on off. Pooran pushes it to long off for another single. 7 runs off it. But there singles won't hurt Afghanistan. The run rate is creeping up for West Indies. They need to hunt down some boundaries now.
Hamid Hassan to bowl!
A single as this is worked towards mid on.
In the air... safe! Loopy ball, full and on off. Chase throws his bat at it. The ball flies high in the air and it lands safely between long on and long off. The batters pick two runs.
Darted, on the pads. Pooran clips it to square leg for a single.
Flatter and on off. Chase pushes it to cover for a single.
Short and on off. Pooran hangs back and pulls it towards mid on, he does not middle it. The ball lands safely and the batters take a single.
Full delivery, on off, Roston Chase drives it to the extra cover fielder in the ring.
Length ball, on off, Chase looks to heave it away across the line but gets the inside half of his blade towards fine leg for a couple.
FOUR! Roston Chase finally gets one away! Short ball, on off, Roston Chase pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, Pooran pulls it hard to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, on off, Chase punches it towards long on for just a single. Good fielding at the deep there.
On a length, outside off, Chase looks to cut but misses.
Shorter, outside off, slashed through backward point for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, around off, defended out.
Fuller, on the pads, Chase clips it to mid on for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg, Chase sweeps but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away towards fine leg.
Fuller, on off, Roston Chase looks to drive but fails to get any timing.
On the pads, flatter, Roston Chase nudges it towards the on side.
WIDE! Rashid delivers this down the leg side. Roston Chase looks to nudge it away but misses. Wide called.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack now.

FOUR! A poor delivery and it has been dispatched. Brings up the 50 for the Windies as well. A half-volley on the pads, nicely flicked away by Pooran to the fine leg fence. 140 more needed in 60 balls!

DRINKS! After the 10 over mark, Afghanistan had crossed 100 runs but all West Indies could put up is half of what the opposition did. They have a steep chase in the remaining phase of play. Afghanistan bowlers did well with the ball and kept things tight. It was all about Nabi who scalped three wickets. They would hope to chip more wickets and take the game away from the Men in Maroon.
WIDE. Down the leg side on a length, NP gets low and looks to hit it to the leg side but misses.
Back of a length, around off, punched to the cover region.
Short, around off, Chase looks to pull but gets the inside edge to the square leg region for one.
Slower, length ball, outside off, Chase swings but misses.
Outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a run.

FOUR! Naveen-ul-Haq completely misjudges this one and makes a meal of it. Around middle, on a length, Nicholas Pooran walks forward and hits this towards long on. Naveen-ul-Haq runs in, realizes he should have stayed back, tries to leap to take it but misses and the ball goes past the ropes on the bounce.
Karim Janat comes into the attack now.
FOUR! That's a very good hit. Fuller, tossed up, around off, Roston Chase slams this one over the bowler and bags a boundary. 151 more needed in 66 balls!
WIDE. Down the leg side, the flick is missed.
Another beauty! It lands around off and spins away nicely, Roston Chase chases after this one but gets beaten.
A quicker and flatter ball on the pads, worked behind square leg for a run.
Shorter around off, bunted back to Rashid by Pooran.
Flatter and quicker on middle, worked through square leg for one.
Tossed up, fuller outside off, it lands and spins away, Chase looks to have a poke but he misses.
Rashid Khan the other master of spin, comes into the attack. He replaces Mohammad Nabi.
5 from this over! On middle, flicked nicely in between fine leg and deep square leg. Two taken comfortably.
Slower, around off, length, this is chipped through the vacant cover-point region for a single.
Short, around middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Good-length on off, Pooran taps this to the off side.
On the pads, nudged to mid-wicket.
Around off, on a length, pushed to the cover fielder.
Quicker, through the air again, outside off, Nicholas Pooran pushes it to point. Dot ball again. End of a brilliant spell by Mohammad Nabi 4-2-2-3!
Flatter, on off, Nicholas Pooran pushes it back to the bowler.
Ohhh another good delivery! Fuller, on off, Nicholas Pooran gets forward and looks to block it but the ball turns away sharply. Beaten!

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Mohammad Nabi gets another one! Fuller, on off, Shimron Hetmyer goes for a drive but is early on the shot. Hits it in the air straight to Nabi. He dropped a one earlier but not this one.
Flatter, shorter, Shimron Hetmyer hits this straight to the fielder at covers in the ring.
Mohammad Nabi darts this quicker, on the pads, Shimron Hetmyer pushes it to mid-wicket.
Full, on off, Shimron Hetmyer pushes it to mid off for just a single. 27/2 after the Powerplay.
GOOD DELIVERY! Fuller, shaping away, around off, Shimron Hetmyer looks to push at it but the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
On a length, on middle, Shimron Hetmyer blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR LEG BYES! Fuller, on the pads, Shimron Hetmyer looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and races away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Naveen-ul-Haq delivers this on a length again, around off, Roston Chase pushes it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
On a length, outside off, Roston Chase looks to push it off the back foot but misses.

A loud appeal for lbw turned down. Loopy ball, full and on middle and leg. Hetmyer prods and looks to defend it out but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. Nabi appeals but the umpire says no. Probably, going down leg.
LEG BYE! Floated, on the pads. Chase misses his flick. The ball goes towards square leg off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Change of bowling. Naveen-ul-Haq to bowl now.
Flatter and on middle. Chase works it to mid-wicket off the inner half.
Full and on the pads. Hetmyer flicks it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. The ball moves away. Hetmyer looks to push it out but misses.

OUT! TIMBER! Nabi is working his magic with the ball here. He redeems himself of the dropped catch earlier. Tossed up, around off. The ball grips and turns away. Lewis looks to defend it out but misses. The ball goes through to come in contact with the off stump. West Indies are two down in no time.
Full and on off, kept out solidly.
In walks Shimron Hetmyer.
Full and on off. Lewis works it to long on for another single.
Flatter and on the stumps. Chase works it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on the stumps. Chase plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter and outside off. Chase taps it to cover-point.
FOUR! Top shot. Short and outside off. Chase hangs back and pushes it through cover-point for a boundary.
TWO WIDES! Full and down leg. Lewis looks to sweep it away but misses. The batters sneak a single. Wide called.
Slower, full and on leg. Chase defends it to the leg side.
Floated, outside off. Chase blocks it out watchfully.
On off, kept out solidly.
Short and on the pads. Lewis flicks it to deep square leg for a single.

DROPPED! This was a sitter and Nabi makes a mess of it. Flighted, around middle and off. Lewis ends up chipping it back to the bowler. He had his eyes on the ball, but as he was about to collect the same, he spills it out. He blames some disturbance from the background.
Darted on the pads, Lewis blocks it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Chase misses his attempt to push it to the off side.
WIDE! Outside off. Chase looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Full and outside off. Chase leaves it alone.
Floated, full and on off. Chase looks to push it away but misses.

FOUR! Nicely played. Chase gets off the mark with a boundary. Full and outside off. Chase leans in and lifts it to the left of mid off. Nabi there dives to his left but the ball goes past him into the boundary.
Full and on middle, Chase tucks it to mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Lewis gets lucky this time. Loopy ball, outside off. The ball moves away a bit. Lewis looks to defend it out, the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards first slip. The fielder there fails to grab the ball and the batters cross for a single.

Another appeal for lbw but turned down yet again. Flighted, full and on off. Chase looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Nabi appeals but the finger stays down. Going down leg.

Close, so close! It ends up as FOUR BYES! Floated, around off. The ball turns in and gets an extra bounce off the pitch. The ball goes over the stumps and past the keeper into the boundary at fine leg.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl from the other end.
An half appeal for lbw turned down! Quicker, flatter and on off. Chase looks to defend it out, but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Swing and a miss! Loopy ball, outside off, the ball turns away a bit. Chase looks to go for the booming drive but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammad Nabi, the skipper rises to the occasion and sents back Lendl Simmons on a 2-ball duck. Floated, full and on off. Simmons gets low and slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. There is a fielder stationed in the deep. Najibullah Zadran comes forward and takes a sharp low catch. Early success for Afghanistan.
Commentary.Howout: c Najibullah Zadran b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: Roston Chase walks out.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Lendl Simmons plays it back to the bowler.
